subject: general
question: What is the central philosophical function of cultural diversity as conveyed by the passage?

options.text: It reinforces national pride and unity.
It affirms the universal superiority of traditional values.
It destabilizes epistemological singularity and fosters pluralistic humility.
It diminishes intellectual agency by proliferating relativism.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage explores cultural diversity through several lenses: historical, sociopolitical, economic, and philosophical.
 
• Regarding the **philosophical level**, the text explicitly states that cultural diversity **"challenges ethnocentric assumptions"** and that engaging with other cultures ensures the **"epistemological arrogance of singular worldviews is destabilized."**</span&
